title: Why your horoscope feels off
caption: A Sun-sign horoscope is written for a twelfth of everyone. You're a whole chart. Try reading yours for your Rising too.

beats.head: It's written for your *Sun* sign only.
beats.sub: That's about one in twelve people, all reading the same forecast.

beats.head: But you're a *whole* chart.
beats.sub: Ten planets, twelve houses, and a Rising sign.

beats.head: Your Sun is your *core.*
beats.sub: Your Moon is your mood. Your Rising is your first impression.

beats.head: Gemini Sun, Capricorn Moon? *Two* moods in one person.
beats.sub: Chatty on the surface, careful with feelings.

beats.head: Tip: read your horoscope for your *Rising* too.
beats.sub: Forecasts lean on the houses, and your houses start from your Rising.

beats.head: Same rule in *dating.*
beats.sub: A sign isn't a person. Don't write anyone off for theirs.

beats.head: The Align app shows their chart before their *face.*
beats.sub: So you meet the whole sky, not just the Sun.

beats.head: Send this to the friend whose horoscope is *always* wrong.
